advancements.hotsteel.area_dig.descripti: Sneak-dig a 3x3 area with a Hot Steel Shovel.
advancements.hotsteel.area_dig.title: Shovel That Hole
advancements.hotsteel.auto_smelt.descrip: Mine an ore with a Hot Steel Pickaxe and get the ingot right away.
advancements.hotsteel.auto_smelt.title: Lava-Forged Mining
advancements.hotsteel.crude_steel.descri: Smelt your very first Crude Steel. Looks a bit rough, honestly.
advancements.hotsteel.crude_steel.title: Is This... Steel?
advancements.hotsteel.fire_wraith.descri: Defeat a Fire Wraith and claim its Molten Core.
advancements.hotsteel.fire_wraith.title: Slay the Wraith
advancements.hotsteel.forge_repair.descr: Repair a damaged piece of Hot Steel gear at the Hot Steel Forge.
advancements.hotsteel.forge_repair.title: Back to the Forge
advancements.hotsteel.full_armor.descrip: Suit up in a full set of Hot Steel armor. Lava? Never heard of her.
advancements.hotsteel.full_armor.title: Burn, Blazing Steel!
advancements.hotsteel.hot_steel_apple.de: Eat a Hot Steel Apple. Yes, it's hot. No, that's the point.
advancements.hotsteel.hot_steel_block.de: Forge a Block of Hot Steel. Good beacon material, honestly.
advancements.hotsteel.hot_steel_chain.de: Craft a Hot Steel Chain — glowing and fireproof.
advancements.hotsteel.hot_steel_hoe.desc: Craft a Hot Steel Hoe. The mod's best material... on a hoe. Respect.
advancements.hotsteel.hot_steel_ingot.de: Get your first Hot Steel Ingot. Yeow — do NOT grab that bare-handed.
advancements.hotsteel.hot_steel_mace.des: Craft a Hot Steel Mace. Fall from great heights for extra damage.
advancements.hotsteel.hot_steel_paxel.de: Forge a Hot Steel Paxel — pick, axe and shovel all in one.
advancements.hotsteel.lava_golem.descrip: Summon a Lava Golem — it floats on lava and burns its enemies.
advancements.hotsteel.lava_golem.title: Molten Bodyguard
advancements.hotsteel.molten_core.descri: Hold a Molten Core — the still-burning heart of a Fire Wraith.
advancements.hotsteel.molten_core.title: A Heart of Fire
advancements.hotsteel.molten_core_use.de: Consume a Molten Core to smelt your entire inventory at once.
advancements.hotsteel.set_bonus_2.descri: Wear 2 pieces of Hot Steel armor to shrug off fire.
advancements.hotsteel.set_bonus_2.title: Flame Ward
advancements.hotsteel.sickle_harvest.des: Harvest a wide swath of crops with a Hot Steel Sickle.
advancements.hotsteel.smelter_use.descri: Toss ore onto a Hot Steel Smelter and watch it turn to ingots.
advancements.hotsteel.smelter_use.title: Instant Smelting
advancements.hotsteel.steel_block.descri: Store your steel in a Block of Steel.
advancements.hotsteel.steel_block.title: Shelf Life
advancements.hotsteel.steel_ingot.descri: Get your first Steel Ingot. Shiny, fireproof, and totally useless... for now.
advancements.hotsteel.steel_ingot.title: Ooh, a Steel Ingot!
advancements.hotsteel.tree_felling.descr: Fell an entire tree with a single Hot Steel Axe chop.
advancements.hotsteel.tree_felling.title: One Swing, Whole Forest
